title: Segmentation-driven MSA/DPA quick-accept flow and price-override simulator
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Large-enterprise sales cycles are frequently delayed by bespoke MSA/DPA negotiation and liability redlines. Sales and Legal spend time on low-risk clauses for high-velocity customers where a standardized quick-accept path would materially shorten time-to-revenue. We also lack a way to translate acceptance thresholds into clear, quantifiable pricing adjustments for risk exposure.

Goal: Build a segmentation-driven quick-accept workflow for low-to-medium risk MSA/DPA redlines that: (1) auto-scores contract deviations against a policy, (2) surface an approved price override when accepting a concession increases exposure, and (3) provides telemetry and guardrails to allow Legal to tune thresholds. Target: reduce average contract cycle time by 30% for deals that meet low-risk signals and capture pricing delta impact automatically.

Approach:
- Input signals: sales tier, ARR band, industry, SSQ score, SOC / compliance territory, historical indemnity exposures.
- Auto-triage: build a deterministic rules engine that maps deviations to a risk score (0-100).
- Fast-accept criteria: risk score <= 18, SSQ score >= 85, ARR band <= $250k or customer in PLG tier.
- Price override simulator: for accepted deviations that increase exposure, automatically propose an ARR-based surcharge (0.5%–4%) computed by a pricing model that factors indemnity cap, revenue, and customer LTV.
- Workflow changes: Sales UI shows "Fast Accept" badge and one-click approve which creates a standardized counterproposal PDF and logs acceptance in contract ledger. Legal gets a batched daily digest of fast-accepts and a rollback endpoint.

Telemetry & success metrics:
- Primary: reduction in median contract turnaround time for eligible deals (target -30% in 90 days).
- Secondary: % revenue processed via Quick-Accept, accuracy of risk score (measured by number of post-accept exceptions flagged by Legal), incremental ARR captured from price overrides.

Rollout plan:
1) Internal pilot with Sales engineering and two Account Exec pods (2 weeks).
2) Canary: enable in one region for self-serve enterprise signups (4 weeks).
3) Ramp: expand to full enterprise team with opt-out (8 weeks).

Acceptance criteria: detailed below.

Notes: This is a product + legal + pricing experiment — needs Legal sign-off and a security review due to automated signing artifacts and ledgering.
acceptance_criteria: Rules engine returns risk score for sample SSQ/clauses within expected range for 95% of test cases
Fast-Accept UI shows badge and one-click approval for eligible deals and blocks others
Price override simulator suggests surcharge and shows P&L impact preview to Sales
Automated counterproposal PDF generated and stored in contract ledger with audit trail
Daily Legal digest includes full list of fast-accepts, score breakdown, and links to artifacts
No regressions in existing contract workflows (smoke tests pass) and telemetry events instrumented
Security review completed and keyed material retention settings compliant with KMS policy
